title: Random walk path distribution
statement: Given a symmetric stochastic real matrix $A$ on $n$ indices, where $n$ is positive, the distribution on paths of length $k$ starts with a uniformly chosen index and then, at each step, chooses the next index according to the row of $A$ corresponding to the current index.
hypotheses_covered: The number of indices is positive
